text.p: British-Borneo Petroleum Syndicate said it has succesfully flow-tested the main reservoir interval in its well recently drilled in the centre of Morpeth field in the Gulf of Mexico.
"This represents a milestone in the development of British Borneo's operating capability in the deep water area of the Gulf of Mexico," chief executive Alan Gaynor said in a statement.
"The well achieved all its objectives leaving British-Borneo on schedule to take a final developemnt decision on the field at year end," Gaynor added.
The well, which is off the coast of Louisiana, is being suspended for future re-entry and tie-in for permanent production facilities.

British-Borneo has a 100 percent working interest in the Morpeth field, located in the Ewing Bank Blocks 921, 964 and 965. The well produced 32 degree API oil at a stabilised rate of 6,000 barrels per day, the oil production and exploration firm said.
